content.text: Amy’s spring and summer at the Clifford farm deepen her love of nature and her bond with thoughtful Webb, while Burt’s impulsive courtship gradually shifts toward sophisticated Miss Hargrove after he rescues her from a rattlesnake in the mountains. Webb realizes he loves Amy but hides it, fearing betrayal of Burt; Amy remains unaware, though she misses Webb’s companionship. The family explores gardens, the Hudson, Moodna Creek, West Point, Idlewild, and a mountain campsite. Storms, floods, drought, fires, and farm work frame the romantic tensions. Miss Hargrove, now in love with Burt, resolves not to interfere if Amy loves him. The latest excursion travels through mountain roads to Fort Putnam, where the party explores Revolutionary ruins.
